pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp edge gradients. Patches on the lower neck and upper flank exhibit higher spatial area compared to the smaller, more fragmented patches appearing toward the ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous graph of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent or tetravalent. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-section, becoming thinner at the base of the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency jagged silhouette is visible along the dorsal ridge of the neck, showing consistent amplitude until the transition to the shoulder.
